svg.title: Pranay Kadu — BackendArchitectX · Systems in motion
svg.desc: Backend Software Engineer. Java 8, 11 and 17, Spring Boot, distributed systems, microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, SQL and Redis. An illustrative 18-second architecture animation assembles a service graph, traces requests, demonstrates a transient failure and bounded retry, and verifies the one-logical-write invariant. This is an architecture simulation, not production telemetry. All profile details also appear as readable Markdown below.

g.text: Assemble the graph. Make ownership explicit.
Transient failure. Keep the idempotency key.
Same key. One logical write. Invariant preserved.
